feature_semantics.log_return_Nm: Close-to-close log return from exact T-N minutes to T; all intervening one-minute bars must be present.
feature_semantics.rolling_price_range_Nm: Max-minus-min close across exact T-N through T, requiring N+1 consecutive one-minute observations.
feature_semantics.realized_volatility_Nm: Root mean square of exactly N consecutive one-minute log returns ending at T.
feature_semantics.relative_volume_3m: Current volume divided by mean volume of exact T-3 through T-1 one-minute observations.
feature_semantics.volume_acceleration_1m: Current volume relative to the exact T-1 one-minute observation.
feature_semantics.cross_market_features: Use same-session exact timestamps only; rolling correlation requires five complete synchronized one-minute return pairs ending at T. Missing pairs remain unavailable.

session_aggregates: Session open/high/low, observed-volume sum, and VWAP summarize observed source bars in the same explicit exchange session; no synthetic zero-volume bars are added.
missing_data_policy: No fill or interpolation. Missing required feature windows emit null values and machine-readable reasons; any selected required null excludes the row from model inputs.
normalization: Fit each feature mean and population standard deviation on TRAIN eligible rows only; freeze and reuse for validation, calibration, walk-forward test, and OOS.
